Flow.description:
WHAT IT DOES: Makes sure an Account has a Party Relationship Group (Nonprofit Cloud's way of saying "this Account is a Household") and hands back the group's Id. Safe to run any number of times: it never creates a second group.
HOW IT WORKS, STEP BY STEP: 1. Reads the Account, mainly for its name. 2. Looks for a group of the requested type (Household unless you say otherwise) already on that Account. 3. Builds the group in the Group (Field Map) transform. The existing group's Id is mapped in, which is the trick that makes step 4 an update instead of a duplicate; the start date is kept and the end date cleared, so a group that had been closed comes back to life. 4. Saves it with a small typed Apex action that upserts on Id: blank Id means insert, a real Id means update. Name and Status are only filled in for a brand-new group, so a group an admin renamed keeps its name. 5. Returns PartyRelationshipGroupId, or HasError plus ErrorMessage when a save failed.
WHERE IT FITS: The NPC Account engine calls this when a form template runs in Household mode, right after the Household Account is saved. It knows nothing about forms, so you can also call it from your own flows whenever you need to guarantee an Account carries a Household group. It never writes logs; whatever calls it decides how to report a failure.
